releaseNotes: First real Primavera functionality: open and analyze XER schedules read-only.
New visual identity: sage and ivory design across every window, with a first-class dark mode.
Open XER from the ribbon; multi-project files ask which project to open.
Project Data: activities, WBS tree, relationships, calendars, resources and expenses.
Schedule Health core checks with clickable drill-down into affected activities.
Export any view to Excel as a clean, formatted worksheet.
Recent projects list and a redesigned dashboard with a real project overview.
